sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: 1987, London-based lawyer and part-time DJ Phil Green cemented a new career endeavour by founding his own modelling agency, aptly titled Supermodel Agency.
sentences.zh: 1987年，伦敦律师兼兼职DJ菲尔·格林创立了自己的模特经纪公司，并将其恰如其分地命名为“超级模特经纪公司”，以此开启了新的职业生涯。

sentences.en: By 2017, Phil was entering his 30th year in the industry, and Supermodel Agency was a major success, representing a large catalogue of glamour models, promo girls,
sentences.zh: 到2017年，菲尔已在这一行深耕了30年，他的公司也取得了巨大成功，代理着大量魅力模特、宣传女郎，

sentences.en: and Instagram influencers.
sentences.zh: 以及Instagram网红。

sentences.en: Many were featured in erotic calendars and men's magazines like FHM, Maxim, Loaded, Nuts, and Zoo Weekly, with the elite appearing in the more illustrious Playboy.
sentences.zh: 她们中的许多人曾登上过色情挂历和男性杂志，如《FHM》、《Maxim》、《Loaded》、《Nuts》和《Zoo Weekly》，而其中的佼佼者甚至登上了更负盛名的《花花公子》。

sentences.en: Several earned a level of popularity as Page Three Girls, a British tabloid tradition where female glamour models were featured topless on the aforementioned page of The Sun,
sentences.zh: 还有几位作为“第三页女郎”获得了一定知名度。这是英国小报的一种传统，即在《太阳报》的第三页刊登女性魅力模特的上空照，

sentences.en: Daily Mirror, and Daily Star newspapers.
sentences.zh: 《每日镜报》和《每日星报》也沿袭了这一传统。

sentences.en: Phil primarily ran his business online, meeting with aspiring models at private residences to assess if they were suitable to join his books.
sentences.zh: 菲尔主要在线上经营业务，他会在私人住所与有抱负的模特会面，评估她们是否适合加入他的公司。

sentences.en: His email inbox was consistently filled with requests from clients from across the world who required models for a variety of purposes, including photo shoots, commercials,
sentences.zh: 他的电子邮箱里总是塞满了来自世界各地客户的请求，他们需要模特来完成各种工作，包括拍摄照片、广告、

sentences.en: corporate events, and parties.
sentences.zh: 企业活动和派对。

sentences.en: No request was off-limits as Phil sent his personnel to a range of jobs, from fetish shoots and jelly wrestling competitions, to trade shows and motor races.
sentences.zh: 对菲尔来说，没有什么是不能接的。他派遣手下的模特从事各种工作，从恋物癖拍摄和果冻摔跤比赛，到贸易展览和赛车活动，应有尽有。

sentences.en: Models with a significant following on social media would occasionally be selected to audition for a role on television as a game show hostess,
sentences.zh: 在社交媒体上拥有大量粉丝的模特有时会被选中参加电视节目的试镜，担任游戏节目的主持人，

sentences.en: or to compete in a reality series like Love Island or Celebrity Big Brother.
sentences.zh: 或者参加像《爱之岛》或《名人老大哥》这样的真人秀节目。

sentences.en: Phil Green took every opportunity to network with the rich and famous,
sentences.zh: 菲尔·格林抓住一切机会与富人和名人建立人脉，

sentences.en: arranging parties at London's trendy nightclubs where he would spend the evening in the VIP area surrounded by a bevy of attractive women half his age.
sentences.zh: 他会在伦敦的时髦夜店安排派对，整晚待在贵宾区，被一群比他年轻一半的迷人女性簇拥着。

sentences.en: If one of his models hooked up with a celebrity or sports star, Phil would put them in touch with tabloid newspaper journalists and earn a cut of the profit for the scoop.
sentences.zh: 如果他旗下的模特与某位名人或体育明星搭上关系，菲尔就会把她们介绍给小报记者，并从中抽取独家新闻的利润分成。

sentences.en: He also pocketed 20% of the sales from photos depicting his models in compromising situations, such as accidental flashes of public nudity, most of which were staged.
sentences.zh: 他还从模特在尴尬处境下的照片销售中抽取20%的提成，比如意外走光，而这些照片大多是摆拍的。

sentences.en: On the morning of Wednesday July 12, 2017, Phil sat down at his computer to check his work emails.
sentences.zh: 2017年7月12日星期三早上，菲尔坐在电脑前查看工作邮件。

sentences.en: His inbox contained the usual array of offers from clients seeking models, but there was one email that stood out from all the others.
sentences.zh: 他的收件箱里有往常那些寻求模特服务的客户发来的邀约，但有一封邮件格外引人注目。

sentences.en: It was sent from an organisation titled The Black Death Group and began.
sentences.zh: 这封邮件来自一个名为“黑死病组织”的机构，开头写道：

sentences.en: We've got Chloe Ayling.
sentences.zh: “我们抓到了克洛伊·艾琳。”

sentences.en: Chloe Ayling never intended to be in the limelight.
sentences.zh: 克洛伊·艾琳从未想过要成为聚光灯下的焦点。

sentences.en: Her initial focus was on academia, studying law, business and psychology at A-level, before moving into sports science.
sentences.zh: 她最初专注于学业，在A-level阶段学习法律、商业和心理学，随后转向体育科学领域。

sentences.en: Regarded as a conventional beauty, she began modelling at 18 years old, complimented for her round, feminine face that was framed by thick, long, wavy blonde hair and a slender,
sentences.zh: 她被视为传统意义上的美女，18岁开始做模特，她那圆润柔美的脸庞被一头浓密、修长、波浪般的金发衬托着，身材纤细，

sentences.en: though shapely figure.
sentences.zh: 却又不失曲线美。

sentences.en: Standing at just 5 foot 3 inches tall, she wasn't suitable for modelling high fashion, which generally required a minimum height of 5 foot 8.
sentences.zh: 她身高仅5英尺3英寸（约1.6米），不适合走秀，因为高级时装模特通常要求身高至少达到5英尺8英寸（约1.73米）。

sentences.en: Instead, Chloe set her sights on glamour and commercial modelling.
sentences.zh: 因此，克洛伊将目光投向了魅力模特和商业模特领域。

sentences.en: The teenager established an online presence by featuring in strip football challenge videos on YouTube,
sentences.zh: 这位少女通过在YouTube上出演脱衣足球挑战视频建立了在线知名度，

sentences.en: where she was tasked with kicking a soccer ball in high heels to her male teammates, who would then take a shot at goal.
sentences.zh: 在视频中，她需要穿着高跟鞋将足球踢给男队友，然后由他们射门。

sentences.en: If they missed, Chloe would have to remove a piece of clothing, the game carrying on until she was standing in the open field as naked as YouTube's rules would allow.
sentences.zh: 如果他们没踢进，克洛伊就得脱掉一件衣服，游戏一直持续到她站在空旷的场地上，身上只剩下YouTube规则允许的底线。

sentences.en: She also took part in prank videos where she participated in staged practical jokes, which involved her having to strip down to her underwear.
sentences.zh: 她还参加过恶作剧视频，参与一些需要她脱到只剩内衣的摆拍整蛊环节。

sentences.en: Chloe didn't earn much for taking part in these videos, but they raised her profile and led to better jobs.
sentences.zh: 克洛伊拍这些视频赚的钱并不多，但它们提高了她的知名度，并为她带来了更好的工作机会。

sentences.en: In August 2016, two months after turning 19, Chloe signed a contract with the supermodel agency and became one of Phil Green's most prominent models,
sentences.zh: 2016年8月，在年满19岁两个月后，克洛伊与超级模特经纪公司签了约，成为了菲尔·格林旗下最出色的模特之一，

sentences.en: amassing hundreds of thousands of followers on her Instagram page by posting a variety of scantily clad, seductive photos.
sentences.zh: 通过发布各种衣着暴露、诱人的照片，她在Instagram上积累了数十万粉丝。

sentences.en: She worked constantly, eventually earning up to £500 per magazine shoot and becoming a popular choice for the Daily Star, the only newspaper that continued to feature page 3 girls.
sentences.zh: 她工作不断，最终每场杂志拍摄最高可赚500英镑，并成为《每日星报》的热门人选，该报是唯一一家坚持刊登“第三页女郎”的报纸。

sentences.en: It therefore came as no surprise to Phil Green, when in March 2017, he received an email from an Italian photographer named Andre Lazio,
sentences.zh: 因此，当菲尔·格林在2017年3月收到一位名叫安德烈·拉齐奥的意大利摄影师发来的邮件时，他并不感到惊讶，

sentences.en: personally requesting Chloe Ayling for a glamour photoshoot in Paris.
sentences.zh: 对方点名要求克洛伊·艾琳去巴黎拍摄一组魅力写真。

sentences.en: His studio was titled Bessie Maffique, and he wanted Chloe to model some leather apparel for a motorcycle magazine advert.
sentences.zh: 他的工作室名为“Bessie Maffique”，他想让克洛伊为一本摩托车杂志的广告拍摄一些皮装照片。

sentences.en: Lazio was straightforward and professional as he detailed the shoot to Phil,
sentences.zh: 拉齐奥在向菲尔详细说明拍摄事宜时，表现得直率且专业，

sentences.en: explaining Chloe would be posing on a motorbike in front of a green screen so that background scenery could be digitally added later.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，克洛伊将在一块绿幕前骑在摩托车上摆姿势，以便后期通过数字技术添加背景场景。

sentences.en: The job included flights, overnight accommodation at the four-star hotel Madeleine Plaza in central Paris, a spa treatment, and spending money.
sentences.zh: 这份工作包括机票、在巴黎市中心四星级酒店马德琳广场酒店的住宿、水疗护理以及零花钱。

sentences.en: As part of his role as a modelling agent, Phil Green was expected to research any potential clients and verify that the jobs they were offering his models were genuine.
sentences.zh: 作为模特经纪人，菲尔·格林有责任调查任何潜在客户，并核实他们为模特提供的工作是否真实。

sentences.en: In his book, Confessions of a Model Agent, Phil said,
sentences.zh: 菲尔在他的书《模特经纪人的自白》中写道：

sentences.en: I checked Andre Lazio's address, and this was perfectly legitimate, even to the point of looking at Google Maps to find the location.
sentences.zh: “我核实了安德烈·拉齐奥的地址，这完全合法，我甚至在谷歌地图上查找了该地点。”

sentences.en: I asked him to send me pictures of previous work he had done, to which he duly obliged.
sentences.zh: “我让他发给我他以前作品的照片，他也照做了。”

sentences.en: He even sent me a picture of his studio, and there above the studio door were the words,
sentences.zh: “他甚至发给我一张他工作室的照片，工作室门上方写着：”

sentences.en: Bessie Maffique, a little Italian temper in the heart of France.
sentences.zh: “‘Bessie Maffique，法国中心的一点意大利风情。’”

sentences.en: Exactly as he said.
sentences.zh: “和他所说的一模一样。”

sentences.en: Satisfied he had confirmed the legitimacy of the job and client, Phil agreed to send Chloe to France for the shoot.
sentences.zh: 在确认了工作和客户的合法性后，菲尔同意派克洛伊去法国参加拍摄。

sentences.en: Chloe was thrilled by the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 克洛伊对这个机会感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: The prospect of travel, glamour, and adventure was exactly what had enticed her into the world of modelling in the first place,
sentences.zh: 旅行、魅力和冒险的愿景正是当初吸引她进入模特界的原因，

sentences.en: and having never been to Paris, she was itching to explore the famed city.
sentences.zh: 而且她从未去过巴黎，迫不及待地想去探索这座著名的城市。

sentences.en: Phil told Chloe that despite having her measurements taken upon joining supermodel agency, she had to come in for a second fitting,
sentences.zh: 菲尔告诉克洛伊，尽管她在加入超级模特经纪公司时已经量过尺寸，但她必须再来做一次试装，

sentences.en: as Lazio requested her exact sizing for the custom-made motorcycle leathers she would be wearing in the shoot.
sentences.zh: 因为拉齐奥要求提供她拍摄时所穿定制摩托车皮装的精确尺寸。

sentences.en: Phil was known as the man with the tape measure, and insisted on measuring all the models himself, claiming to have been duped in the past by women who lied about their dimensions.
sentences.zh: 菲尔被称为“卷尺先生”，坚持亲自测量所有模特，声称过去曾被谎报尺寸的女性欺骗过。

sentences.en: Chloe reluctantly agreed.
sentences.zh: 克洛伊勉强同意了。

sentences.en: To ensure she had as much time as possible to experience the foreign city,
sentences.zh: 为了确保有尽可能多的时间去体验这座外国城市，

sentences.en: Chloe requested the earliest flight available to Paris, and the latest one to leave.
sentences.zh: 克洛伊要求预订最早飞往巴黎的航班，以及最晚离开的航班。

sentences.en: Upon landing on the morning of Thursday April 20, a driver was awaiting her arrival at the gate, holding a sign with her name in big black letters.
sentences.zh: 4月20日星期四早上抵达后，一名司机在登机口等候她，手里举着一块写有她名字的黑色大字牌子。

sentences.en: She was driven to her hotel where she checked in and deposited her luggage before heading out to see the Eiffel Tower.
sentences.zh: 她被送往酒店办理入住并放下行李，随后出发去参观埃菲尔铁塔。

sentences.en: As she walked the three and a half kilometres to the famous landmark,
sentences.zh: 当她步行三公里半前往这个著名地标时，

sentences.en: Chloe video called Phil on her mobile phone so she could show him the sights.
sentences.zh: 克洛伊用手机给菲尔打了视频电话，向他展示沿途的风景。

sentences.en: She reached the tower and took a selfie underneath before moving off to have dinner on her own at a nearby restaurant.
sentences.zh: 她到达铁塔并在下方自拍，随后离开，独自在附近的一家餐厅用餐。

sentences.en: Chloe arrived back to her hotel later that evening, but her plans of a relaxing night were interrupted by the screech of emergency vehicle sirens outside.
sentences.zh: 克洛伊当晚晚些时候回到酒店，但她享受宁静夜晚的计划被窗外急救车辆的警笛声打断了。

sentences.en: She received a text message from a friend alerting her to a headline that had appeared online, which read,
sentences.zh: 她收到朋友发来的一条短信，提醒她注意网上出现的一条头条新闻，上面写着：

sentences.en: Terror hits Paris as policemen shot on the Champs-Élysées.
sentences.zh: “巴黎发生恐怖袭击，香榭丽舍大街有警察遭枪击。”

sentences.en: Chloe bunkered down in her room as news of the shooting began to filter through.
sentences.zh: 随着枪击事件的消息不断传来，克洛伊躲在房间里不敢出门。

sentences.en: Around the time she had been eating dinner, a gunman wielding an AK-47 rifle roamed the Champs-Élysées shopping boulevard one kilometre away.
sentences.zh: 就在她吃晚饭的时候，一名持AK-47步枪的枪手在距离她一公里外的香榭丽舍购物大道上横行。

sentences.en: One police officer was killed and two others, as well as a German tourist, were seriously injured.
sentences.zh: 一名警察被杀，另有两名警察和一名德国游客受重伤。

sentences.en: The perpetrator was shot dead and found to be carrying a list of police station addresses he had planned to ambush, along with a note praising jihadist militant group ISIS.
sentences.zh: 行凶者被当场击毙，身上被发现携带了一份他计划袭击的警察局地址清单，以及一张赞扬圣战武装组织ISIS的字条。

sentences.en: As such, the incident was declared a terror attack.
sentences.zh: 因此，该事件被定性为恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: The next morning, Chloe received a phone call from Andre Lazio, the photographer overseeing the motorcycle photo shoot.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，克洛伊接到了负责摩托车写真拍摄的摄影师安德烈·拉齐奥的电话。

sentences.en: He informed Chloe that his studio had been ransacked during the chaos of the terror attack and that all of his camera equipment and lighting gear had been stolen.
sentences.zh: 他告诉克洛伊，他的工作室在恐怖袭击的混乱中遭到洗劫，所有的摄像器材和灯光设备都被偷走了。

sentences.en: Lazio had no choice but to cancel the shoot and was sending a prepaid taxi to collect Chloe from the hotel and take her back to the airport.
sentences.zh: 拉齐奥别无选择，只能取消拍摄，并派了一辆预付车费的出租车去酒店接克洛伊回机场。

sentences.en: Frustrated but understanding,
sentences.zh: 虽然感到沮丧，但克洛伊表示理解，

sentences.en: Chloe finished her breakfast and checked out before jumping into a car that was waiting at the front of the hotel.
sentences.zh: 她吃完早餐并办理了退房手续，随后坐上了等在酒店门前的车。

sentences.en: It wasn't until she arrived at the airport that Chloe realised she had gotten into the wrong car.
sentences.zh: 直到抵达机场，克洛伊才意识到自己上错了车。

sentences.en: The driver demanded cash for the trip, but she didn't have any as she had been expecting to receive her expenses later that day.
sentences.zh: 司机要求支付车费，但她身上没带现金，因为她原本打算当天晚些时候才收到报销款。

sentences.en: Chloe scrolled through her mobile phone until she found the email containing Andre Lazio's contact number and promptly called him, passing the phone to the driver
sentences.zh: 克洛伊在手机里翻找，找到了包含安德烈·拉齐奥联系电话的邮件，并立即拨通了电话，把手机递给司机，

sentences.en: so the two of them could resolve the situation.
sentences.zh: 让他们两人解决这个问题。

sentences.en: After a conversation in French, the driver informed Chloe she was to wait in the car until Lazio arrived with the payment.
sentences.zh: 经过一番法语交谈，司机告诉克洛伊，她必须在车里等拉齐奥带着钱过来。

sentences.en: Eventually, a lean Caucasian man with cropped dark hair wearing sporty sunglasses appeared at the window, introducing himself as Andre Lazio.
sentences.zh: 最终，一名身材瘦削、留着短黑发、戴着运动太阳镜的白人男子出现在车窗旁，自我介绍说他是安德烈·拉齐奥。

sentences.en: For an experienced senior photographer,
sentences.zh: 对于一位经验丰富的资深摄影师来说，

sentences.en: Lazio appeared remarkably young to Chloe, seemingly under 30 years old.
sentences.zh: 拉齐奥在克洛伊看来显得异常年轻，似乎还不到30岁。

sentences.en: He paid the driver and apologised profusely to Chloe both for cancelling the shoot and for the mix-up with the car.
sentences.zh: 他付了车费，并就取消拍摄以及坐错车的事向克洛伊连连道歉。

sentences.en: He seemed agitated and keen to get going, giving Chloe her promise to £90 for expenses before leaving her to wait several hours for her scheduled flight home.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很焦躁，急着要走，给了克洛伊承诺的90英镑报销款，然后就离开了，留下克洛伊等待几个小时后预定的回国航班。

sentences.en: Although she didn't get to complete the shoot, the trip wasn't a complete write-off for Chloe.
sentences.zh: 虽然没能完成拍摄，但这次旅行对克洛伊来说并非一无所获。

sentences.en: Back in London, the Daily Star newspaper wrote an article about how one of their top Page 3 models was caught up in Paris during the recent terror attack,
sentences.zh: 回到伦敦后，《每日星报》写了一篇关于他们的一位顶级“第三页女郎”在巴黎恐怖袭击期间被困的文章，

sentences.en: accompanying the story with a topless picture of Chloe.
sentences.zh: 并配上了一张克洛伊的上空照。

sentences.en: A few months later,

sentences.en: The closest place to buy food and supplies was a 15-minute drive away in Vieux, a picturesque alpine town with a grocery store, cafes, and shops.
sentences.zh: 购买食物和补给最近的地方是15分钟车程外的维厄，那是一个风景如画的高山小镇，有杂货店、咖啡馆和商店。

sentences.en: Although Vieux was busy during the snow season, it was quiet during the summer, and strangers in the town stood out.
sentences.zh: 虽然维厄在雪季很繁忙，但夏天却很安静，镇上的陌生人非常显眼。

sentences.en: Local traders were shown photographs of Chloe and her male consulate companion, and several recognised MD right away.
sentences.zh: 当地商贩被展示了克洛伊和她那位领事馆同伴的照片，几个人立刻认出了MD。

sentences.en: He had visited the town to dine at the local pizza restaurant nearly every day of Chloe's captivity, with the owner of the Minimart telling police
sentences.zh: 在克洛伊被囚禁的几乎每一天，他都会去镇上的披萨店用餐，迷你超市的老板告诉警察，

sentences.en: that he had been into the store three or four times to purchase groceries.
sentences.zh: 他曾三四次进店购买杂货。

sentences.en: On the morning of Chloe's auction, witnesses saw him at the Minimart again, but this time he was in the company of a blonde-haired woman.
sentences.zh: 在克洛伊被拍卖的那天早上，目击者再次在迷你超市看到了他，但这次他身边有一位金发女子。

sentences.en: The pair appeared to be a couple, holding hands and wearing matching outfits consisting of tracksuit pants and white T-shirts.
sentences.zh: 两人看起来像是一对情侣，手牵着手，穿着配套的运动裤和白色T恤。

sentences.en: The woman, who was positively identified as Chloe Ayling, had been left standing outside the store while MD went in to buy fruit.
sentences.zh: 这名女子被确认为克洛伊·艾琳，她被留在店外，而MD进去买水果。

sentences.en: The pair were also seen shopping in a shoe store, where MD purchased Chloe a pair of running shoes that cost around 40 euros.
sentences.zh: 两人还被看到在一家鞋店购物，MD在那里给克洛伊买了一双价值约40欧元的跑鞋。

sentences.en: CCTV footage collected from the streets of Vieux confirmed these sightings, capturing Chloe and her alleged kidnapper leisurely strolling hand-in-hand in broad daylight.
sentences.zh: 从维厄街头收集的闭路电视录像证实了这些目击情况，画面捕捉到克洛伊和她所谓的绑架者在大白天悠闲地手牵手散步。

sentences.en: This evidence provided a stark contrast to the allegations made by Chloe, who told police she was not permitted to leave the farmhouse where she was being held.
sentences.zh: 这些证据与克洛伊的指控形成了鲜明对比，她曾告诉警察，她被囚禁在农舍里，不被允许离开。

sentences.en: After 15 hours of interrogation, police confronted Chloe with this discrepancy, causing her to break down in tears.
sentences.zh: 经过15小时的审讯，警察用这一矛盾之处与克洛伊对质，导致她崩溃大哭。

sentences.en: Chloe revealed that upon securing her release,
sentences.zh: 克洛伊透露，在确保她获释后，

sentences.en: MD made plans to drop her off a 20-minute walk away from the British consulate in Milan.
sentences.zh: MD计划把她放在距离米兰英国领事馆步行20分钟的地方。

sentences.en: But as her jacket, jeans and sneakers had been left in the abandoned building following her abduction, she had no clothing or shoes to facilitate the journey.
sentences.zh: 但由于她的夹克、牛仔裤和运动鞋在被绑架后留在了那栋废弃建筑里，她没有衣服和鞋子来完成这段路程。

sentences.en: She borrowed a tracksuit from MD and on the morning of Sunday July 16, he decided to take her shopping for shoes.
sentences.zh: 她向MD借了一套运动服，7月16日星期日早上，他决定带她去买鞋。

sentences.en: For the first time since her captivity,
sentences.zh: 这是自她被囚禁以来，

sentences.en: Chloe was allowed downstairs and out of the farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 克洛伊第一次被允许下楼并走出农舍。

sentences.en: MD drove her to Vieux, asserting that Black Death operatives were everywhere, rendering Chloe too afraid to scream or ask anyone for help.
sentences.zh: MD开车送她去维厄，声称“黑死”组织无处不在，这让克洛伊太害怕了，不敢尖叫或向任何人求助。

sentences.en: As she couldn't speak Italian, she was also nervous that she wouldn't be understood even if she did manage to get someone's attention.
sentences.zh: 由于她不会说意大利语，她也很担心即使成功引起别人的注意，对方也听不懂她的话。

sentences.en: Firmly believing that earning MD's trust was her only chance of escaping, she maintained her romantic facade, holding his hand as they strolled through the village together.
sentences.zh: 她坚信赢得MD的信任是她逃脱的唯一机会，因此维持着浪漫的伪装，在他们一起漫步村庄时牵着他的手。

sentences.en: The visit to the shoe shop was brief.
sentences.zh: 在鞋店的停留很短暂。

sentences.en: Chloe never spoke to the staff members, simply pointing to the first pair of trainers she saw and buying them in a slightly bigger size as they didn't have her own.
sentences.zh: 克洛伊没有和店员说话，只是指了指她看到的第一双运动鞋，因为没有她的尺码，就买了大一号的。

sentences.en: On the way back to the car,

sentences.en: The next morning, the plan to drop Chloe near the consulate was abandoned when they arrived to Milan two hours before the building was due to open.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，当他们提前两小时到达米兰，而领事馆还没开门时，把克洛伊放在领事馆附近的计划被放弃了。

sentences.en: Instead, they headed to a cafe for breakfast, where MD advised the new plan was for Chloe to tell the consulate staff that she had escaped, borrowed a phone from a stranger
sentences.zh: 相反，他们去了一家咖啡馆吃早餐，MD建议新计划是让克洛伊告诉领事馆工作人员她逃了出来，向陌生人借了电话，

sentences.en: and called him to accompany her.
sentences.zh: 并打电话让他来陪她。

sentences.en: Investigators were sceptical of Chloe's changing story and she was forced to remain in a safe house in Italy while the investigations continued.

sentences.en: After being informed that she would not be allowed to return home until she had provided police with all the evidence they needed, she agreed to participate in video interviews

sentences.en: over the following days, in which she escorted investigators on a tour of the locations of her kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，她带领调查人员参观了她被绑架的地点。

sentences.en: She was remarkably calm as she pulled on blue latex gloves and took the police to André Lazio's phony photography studio, the ramshackle two-storey farmhouse,
sentences.zh: 她非常冷静地戴上蓝色乳胶手套，带着警察去了安德烈·拉齐奥的虚假摄影工作室、那栋摇摇欲坠的两层农舍，

sentences.en: and the shops in nearby VU where they had purchased her shoes.
sentences.zh: 以及附近维厄的商店，他们在那里买了鞋子。

sentences.en: At the farmhouse, she broke down upon discovering the property was not as remote as she was led to believe, with occupied houses neighbouring both sides,
sentences.zh: 在农舍，当她发现这处房产并不像她被误导的那样偏僻，两侧都有住人的房屋时，她崩溃了，

sentences.en: Composing herself, she took the investigators on a tour of the house, where everything, down to the colours of the bedspreads and the walls,
sentences.zh: 她平复了一下情绪，带着调查人员参观了房子，那里的一切，甚至床罩和墙壁的颜色，

sentences.en: The press clamoured for an interview with the young model, but she continued to be held by the Italian police.

sentences.zh: 然而，他无法提供任何证据证明他被诊断出患有这种危及生命的癌症或正在接受任何治疗，随后他因

sentences.zh: 在被警方拘留期间，

sentences.en: News of the attack reached Chloe Ayling, who felt a mix of sympathy and fear, wondering who would protect her from the Black Death Group now that Wukasz was in prison.
sentences.zh: 袭击的消息传到了克洛伊·艾琳耳中，她感到既同情又恐惧，想知道既然武卡什已经入狱，谁来保护她免受“黑死”组织的伤害。
